title: Phantom Drop
summary: Rust CLI and library for testnet gift envelopes using native stealth outputs and claim/refund branches, without a custom template. Links can include riddles and expiry. Anyone holding a plain link can claim it; riddle strength and public transaction timing limit privacy. The creator published October 12 Esmeralda seal/open/refund evidence; this listing reviews source and those links, without executing the CLI or a wallet transaction. October 20: the linked browser walkthrough offers a chain/link-holder toggle and five narrated acts. Real clicks changed the riddle, expiry and replay panels. These are a replay of the maintainer example, not new engine execution or network transactions.
cardSummary: Create expiring testnet gift links with a Rust CLI, optional riddles and refunds for unopened envelopes.
creator: hycorange

recording.credit: Concept overview — Interactive narrated browser replay; no live transaction.
